relations.text: AECOMから分離した会社。売買契約をめぐる訴訟で和解
relations.text_en: Divested from AECOM; settled a lawsuit over the sale agreement

source.label: Shimmick 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Reached an agreement with AECOM to resolve a previous lawsuit relating to the purchase and sale agreement for the divestiture of Shimmick from AECOM in exchange for shares of our common stock.

source.quote: we have engaged AECOM, a global infrastructure leader, under a master services agreement to support site-specific engineering, environmental analysis and regulatory planning at UIUC.
